title: Rules for the Dinosaur Petting Farm
text:

title: Welcome to the Fossil Hall
text:

On your left is the biggest dinosaur skeleton in the whole state. Scientists found it in a farmer's {noun} in 1952. They think this dinosaur was very {adjective} and liked to {verb} in the afternoon. title: An Interview with a Triceratops
text:

title: How to Give a Brontosaurus a Bath
